purpose: Capture the raw owner+0x10 value once at the exact descriptor-correlated dungeon root event and expose the result through the existing Surveyor root-dispatch status.
measured_facts: The capture is gated by exact descriptor correlation at the dungeon root event.
The hook performs one read of 8 bytes at owner+0x10 using the existing safe current-process read helper.
The raw value and best-effort loaded-module identity are included in exact-root evidence and live status.
No NMS memory writes are added.
inferences: A loaded module RVA identifies an address location, not the C++ semantic type of the slot value.
hypotheses: The owner+0x10 value may identify runtime dispatch behavior; live capture and further analysis are required.

steps: Use Surveyor Check app update and Install update for app 0.3.49.
Start NMS from Surveyor so the staged Runtime-A probe 0.3.34 is loaded.
Load the same known derelict and wait for Root dispatch +0x10 to report CAPTURED.
Click Analyze generation + upload and verify the runtime-dispatch receipt.
human_validation.success_condition: Surveyor root-dispatch state and objective show captured; the lane upload contains owner+0x10 capture data.
